scope: Daily comparison of the actual public feed and current main against the last publicly verified review: five new records and three records with changed descriptions. Only title and necessary description corrections; no publication, removal, restoration or date changes.

sourceEvidence.krapfen: Current approved metaGraphCaption of meta-ig-18117531122064201, official account tuchlauben.eis: 6 Krapfen um 9 Euro; 10 um 13 statt 20 Euro; Landstrasser Hauptstrasse 2; until 11 November 2026.
sourceEvidence.ikeaKids: Existing exact official merchant-card evidence in power-food-9e109bce4885, independently re-read from https://www.ikea.com/at/de/food/ on 24 October: adult Family member buys a warm main dish from 4.99 Euro, up to two children age 12 or younger receive one kids menu each. Business members also eligible; full original description retained.
sourceEvidence.circus: Approved metaGraphCaption of meta-ig-18119597047978765: Monday child admission 7 Euro, Zirkus Alex Kaiser, Leopoldauer Strasse, 1210 Vienna, through 15 November. This is a source excerpt, not a new merchant availability check.
sourceEvidence.bubbleTea: Approved merchant TikTok description of tiktok-hog7yq and its retained caption: buy one portion of Gyoza or Xiao Long Bao and receive one Bubble Tea. No exact end date given.
sourceEvidence.subway: Approved headline, merchant and exact Lieferando branch URL; archived matching pending record g2-4dgo1u. Direct official ordering page returned HTTP 403 on 24 October, not bypassed. No exact product, threshold or campaign validity inferred.
sourceEvidence.nordsee: Each current record retains evidence.textSample with the exact original coupon and all material conditions. Both descriptions were nonempty in the last public review and are now blank. Restore the full original evidence, without changing date fields or claiming a new source check.

changes.reason: Name the already approved merchant and ordering channel while retaining selected-product scope. Do not guess sandwiches, exclusions or a minimum spend from the inaccessible page.

fields.title: 10 Krapfen für 13 € statt 20 €
fields.description: Bei Tuchlauben Eis in der Landstraßer Hauptstraße 2, 1030 Wien: 10 Krapfen für 13 € statt 20 € (35 % Ersparnis). Alternativ gibt es 6 Krapfen für 9 €. Laut Anbieter gilt die Aktion bis einschließlich 11.11.2026.

changes.reason: Replace an unexplained percentage with the precise product, required quantity and total price from the verified merchant caption. Preserve the second pack option, location and source end date in the description.

fields.title: IKEA Family: Kindermenü gratis zum Hauptgericht ab 4,99 €

changes.reason: The free meal requires a qualifying adult main dish and membership. Make both visible in the headline, retaining the complete two-child limit, age, dates, Business eligibility, restaurant-only and stock conditions in the unchanged description.

fields.title: Zirkus Alex Kaiser: Kinderticket montags für 7 €
fields.description: Laut dem verlinkten Beitrag zahlen Kinder montags beim Zirkus Alex Kaiser 7 € Eintritt. Standort: Leopoldauer Straße, 1210 Wien. Der Beitrag nennt den 15.11.2026 als letzten Veranstaltungstag. Konkrete Vorstellung und Teilnahmebedingungen vor dem Besuch beim Veranstalter prüfen.

changes.reason: Name the admission and circus rather than retaining emoji/social-caption fragments. Keep the Monday restriction and distinguish the reported final event day from fresh availability confirmation.

fields.title: Bubble Tea gratis zu Gyoza oder Xiao Long Bao
fields.description: Bei DimsumBabe im Wiener Westbahnhof eine Portion Gyoza oder Xiao Long Bao kaufen und einen Bubble Tea gratis dazu erhalten. Quelle ist der verlinkte TikTok-Beitrag von @dimsumbabe_at. Die Aktion ist nur für begrenzte Zeit angekündigt; ein genaues Enddatum ist nicht angegeben. Verfügbarkeit vor der Bestellung beim Lokal bestätigen.

changes.reason: The drink is not unconditionally free: name the required food purchase, retain one portion and one drink in the details, and do not invent an expiry.

fields.description: 2 Alaska-Seelachsfilets gebacken & Beilage: 1+1 gratis Gutschein. Gültig bis 30.11.2026 in allen teilnehmenden Restaurants in Österreich. Nicht gültig an Autobahnraststätten. Serviervorschlag

changes.reason: Description-only correction: the previously reviewed description was lost although the exact original evidence remains in the current record. Restore the coupon, participation and excluded-rest-stop conditions verbatim; title and expiry fields stay unchanged.

Previously unresolved exact product/merchant for the meter-food offer remains unchanged; no guessed pizza or schnitzel added.
